name: loopin
description: LoopIn – Need it? Loop it. Campus-sharing platform for students.

scripts.dev:backend: npm run build --workspace=backend && npm run start --workspace=backend
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=shared && npm run build --workspace=frontend && npm run build --workspace=backend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=shared && npm run typecheck --workspace=frontend && npm run typecheck --workspace=backend && npm run typecheck --workspace=tests
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=frontend && npm run lint --workspace=backend
